QUIC/WebTransport H3 | Multicast to PIM SDK
AMT Relay source | PUSH to preposition
Caddy cdni_log handler → gRPC cdni_log.proto → blockcastd → Cloud
DRIAD: source rDNS query -> TR balancer -> amtr address
Multi-repo: trafficcontrol + pim-multicast-gateway + go-amt + linux-amt. Integration via AMT, DRIAD (RFC 8777), MoQ.
LUKS cache-init: Encrypted cache with K8s Secret. RKS mTLS: Token (group->node, 10min TTL) or cert (DNS-SD SAN) auth with memguard.
